author: Lori Weinstein
text: Awesome service! We have used Avalon septic multiple times, but when we had a septic issue, he rearranged his schedule to get us in in a timely matter. He genuinely cares about his clients and always has great customer service. Highly recommend! If I could give more than 5 stars I would!!

author: Robert Nicolai
text: Jeff was amazing. He checked over my entire septic system, made recommendations how to keep things working smoothly, made sure our filter was clean, and that the drain field looked in proper health! He was able to get us on his schedule within a quick time frame, and the price was very reasonable. Can't be happier with quality service from a local small business that treats customers with respect, while offering a superior service. Highly Recommended!

author: Malina Righter
text:
Jeff is incredibly kind, personable, and easy to work with.

Having just moved into a new home, and also being new to owning a septic system, we were a little worried when we began noticing a smell around our septic tank.

After reading several glowing reviews, I reached out to Jeff to have him take a look at our system and pump it if necessary. Even though we were outside of his usual service range, Jeff was kind enough to come and check things out. He reassured us that just a routine pump was needed, cleaned out our filter, and even offered to recommend some contacts for farm animals for our homestead in the future. He was super nice, good-humored, and easy to talk to. We feel like our system is in good hands with Jeff and we look forward to working with him in the future.

Thanks for a fantastic job, Jeff! We appreciate your help!

author: Sydney Free
text: Recently called to get our tank(s) inspected and pumped. They returned my call promptly, were very friendly and personable, and came by our place within a few days. Highly recommend!

author: Mike Ludvik
text: Avalon is an awesome company, and Jeff made it quick and easy. I went with Avalon because of others' 5-star ratings, and I'm glad I did. I'll be a repeat customer.
